name: split-screen
title: Split screen
description: Two full-height halves, one for the task and one for a brand panel or picture, which folds away on a phone.
docs: children is the task and becomes the main landmark; media is the other half. mediaSide is start or end (default end), ratio is 1:1 or 3:2, which gives the task three parts and the media two. mediaOnMobile is what the media does below 48rem of width: hidden (the default), banner (a short strip above the task) or top (a taller block above it), so the form is never pushed below the fold. stickyMedia (on by default) pins the media to the screen while a long task scrolls past; off, the media grows as tall as the task. mediaLabel makes the media a labelled complementary region; without it the media is decorative and hidden from assistive technology. height is the height of one screen, 100dvh by default; give it a length to fill a box. mediaClassName and taskClassName reach the halves. mainAs is main (the default) or div, for a second layout on one page, a preview or a dialog, because a page has one main landmark. In the document the task comes first, whichever side the picture is on.
